catalog.name: gutenberg-multiregister-v1
catalog.provider: Project Gutenberg (cache/epub text files, selection rule in scripts/acquire_gutenberg_corpus.py)

limitations: a sample of URLs cannot bound the drift of the whole catalogue, and an unchanged sample is not an all-clear over the pinned corpus. A URL that now 404s, redirects or serves different bytes does not invalidate the pin: the archive holds the pinned bytes and the catalogue's raw digest still selects them. Drift is judged by content digest, because the policy-enforcing fetcher returns bytes rather than response headers, so Last-Modified and ETag moves are invisible here by construction. The classification of a moved source is computed from the bytes fetched today, and this command opens the catalogue read-only and writes nothing outside a temporary directory.

policy.user_agent: chakaso-corpus-drift-rescan/1.0 (language-model research; verifying pinned corpus digests)

selection.rule: sha256("rescan|" + slug) per register, lowest ranks first
